At that moment, Nathalie, a young doctor who has just finished her residency and who also has extensive experience as a nurse, arrives in the village. She will be in charge of helping Pierre with his work when he can't, but it will be a professional challenge because she has never worked in a medical office in a small town. In this way, it will also be complicated for Jean-Pierre because for him his work is the most important thing, so he will have to learn to deal with his new partner.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, commander of the team, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Mutiny on board
programme.desc: In 1787, the ship Bounty made a dangerous journey of 50,000 kilometers. After a month of sailing under strong storms, Captain William Bligh allows the crew to dock on a remote island so that they can rest. After seeing the situation of lack of control among the sailors, the captain insists on returning to the boat to continue his trip. However, the second in command, Fletcher Christian, will support his men.

programme.title: the ghostbusters
programme.desc: Dr. Peter Venkman (Bill Murray) takes advantage of his research scholarship at the University to torture boys and conquer girls who take psychosensory tests. He is actually a very capable scientist who resorts to logic rather than superstition, but he uses the girls' gullibility to flirt with them. His friends, Dr. Raymond Stantz (Dan Aykroyd) and Dr. Egon Spengler (Harold Ramis), carry out ectoplasmic studies to investigate the possible existence of ghosts and even capture one for later study. The first time they have a warning about the real presence of a ghost in a library, they don't know how to deal with it and run away. It is after they are kicked out of the University that they decide to mortgage Stantz's house and start their own ghost hunting company. Over time they manage to develop machines that trap ectoplasmic beings for later study. But the jobs that come to the office are nonsense with what is about to fall on them. A young woman who lives alone begins to have truly shocking paranormal experiences in her home and decides to call the Ghostbusters to help her. The investigation will take them further than they ever thought they would go, seeing things they would never have dreamed of seeing. In Aykroyd's original script, the story took place in a future where there would be teams of ghostbusters like there are today of paramedics or firefighters. But the budget studied for that type of film amounted to three hundred million dollars and Aykroyd was forced to adapt it to the scientific reality of the 1980s. Initially other actors were going to play some of the most important roles in the film: John Candy was going to be Louis Tully, John Belushi was going to be Dr. Peter Venkman, and the role of Winston was written specifically for Eddie Murphy.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The Ghostbusters discover that New York is once again headed toward supernatural disaster, with a river of ectoplasmic matter running beneath the city and an old sorcerer attempting to take possession of a baby. to be born again.

programme.title: The jewel of the Nile
programme.desc: Jack and Joan are about to get married on a boat on the high seas. But suddenly a horde of pirates attack them and set fire to the facilities. Joan and Jack fight off the tenacious pirates when they realize there is only one place left on the lifeboat. Joan asks Jack to take care of it since she is going to die soon of tuberculosis and it is not worth the man dying. When he leaves she wonders what the buccaneers will do and what her future will be... But this incredible adventure was only part of Joan Wilder's fantasy with which she intends to start writing her new book, in which she is stuck. She has been married to Jack Colton for some time and after the incredible adventures they have had, they find themselves stuck in a port in the south of France bound for Greece, although she would prefer to go to New York. That same afternoon, at a book signing, Joan meets Omar, a benevolent ruler of an Eastern country called Kadir. He invites her to his palace so she can feel like a queen while he writes, but Jack is not amused by this proposition. Quarreled, they decide to separate and take some time while she finishes her book. Suddenly, Joan witnesses how a man named Tarak tries to murder Omar in front of her. For his part, Jack meets a man named Ralph at the port who seeks revenge for his time spent in prison. They both see how a man approaches: it is Tarak, the murderer, who comes to ask them for help. He confesses to them that Omar is actually a horrible dictator who has stolen their most precious treasure, "The Jewel of the Nile." Jack decides to help him when he sees his ship explode and understands that the sheikh intended to kill him and thus, in the process, rescues his wife. But the sheik has great power and it will be very difficult for Jack and Ralph to get their way. The actors who play the tribesmen: Arak, Barak, Karak, Sarak and Tarak, the same ones from the troop of jugglers in The Brothers Karamazov.

programme.title: The Blind Side (Un sueño posible)
programme.desc: A young homeless African-American finds refuge in a white family, who will support him in his desire to become an American football player. Based on true events, the film tells the story of Michael Oher (Quinton Aaron), a teenager who tries to survive on his own, practically "homeless" until Leigh Anne Tuohy (Sandra Bullock) finds him on the street. Upon discovering that he is his daughter's classmate, he decides to take him home. Little by little, Michael will become part of the family. Sandra Bullock won an Oscar for best actress for her performance and the film was a success at the American box office.

programme.title: Absolute power
programme.desc: Luther, a specialist in grand thefts, plans to rob the mansion of a tycoon who is on vacation in the Caribbean. However, the victim's wife appears unexpectedly.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Dr. Franks is a prestigious neurosurgeon who is going to carry out a unique and very dangerous operation: implant the memories, secrets and abilities of CIA agent Bill Pope who has just died in the mind of another person. This is a cutting-edge method that is presented as the only way the agency has to recover confidential information of vital importance from Pope's memory that compromises the national security of the United States. The problem is that the only candidate to become the vessel of the deceased's mind is Jericho Stewart, a dangerous and unpredictable convict who is on death row awaiting execution and who has a brain abnormality that makes him perfect for the mission. However, no one can assure that the result is the most effective way to stop a terrible conspiracy that is hanging over the country.

programme.title: The Kaiser's Last Kiss
programme.desc: A German officer is sent to Holland to determine whether the British Secret Service has infiltrated the home of Kaiser Wilhelm II during the start of World War II, but begins a dangerous and lethal romance with a young Dutch Jew with consequences neither of them could have foreseen.

programme.title: The client
programme.desc: Mark Sway is an eleven-year-old boy who witnesses the death of a mafia lawyer. Before dying, he confesses some very important information to him. But, fearing retaliation, Mark doesn't dare tell the FBI. The FBI pressures Mark to reveal the lawyer's last words, but he, aware that the mafia is watching him, decides to hire a lawyer to protect him. Adaptation of the best seller of the same name by John Grisham, directed by Joel Schumacher (''A Day of Fury'', ''Batman Forever''). Its plot starting point is vaguely reminiscent of that of ''Sole Witness'', although the Mormon community that surrounded Harrison Ford in Peter Weir's film is replaced here by a single character: that of a devoted lawyer. For this reason, the true core of the film, despite being a thriller, is not the judicial plot, but the relationship established between the boy, played by Brad Renfro (chosen from 5,000 candidates), and his lawyer, a role entrusted to Susan Sarandon, for which she was nominated for an Oscar for best actress. Tommy Lee Jones gave life to the third party, in the shoes of an ambitious prosecutor.

programme.title: Deuda de sangre
programme.desc: When Terry McCaleb is called to a crime scene where his partners Detective Waller and Arrango are waiting for him, he can't even imagine how events will unfold. Victims five and six of the latest series of murders await him, and on a wall is written in blood "McCaleb, fuck me if you can" and a number code. As Terry tries to avoid giving answers to the reporters, he encounters one with blood on his shoes. He will chase him but when he almost catches him, he suffers a heart attack and falls to the ground. The suspect approaches and looks at him and Terry shoots him in the fog he sees without knowing if he has really wounded him. 2 years later, Terry is going to have some tests after his heart transplant. His doctor, Dr. Fox, gives him the all-clear before the retired agent goes to his ship, where he meets Graciella Rivers. The woman wants to hire him to investigate the disappearance of her nephew: Raymond. He also tells him that the heart that Terry has received is from Graciella's own sister. The next day the retired agent will meet with his former colleagues, who show him a security tape of a small store where there has been a murder. Even though it is prohibited, Terry will go there to ask questions to begin his investigation until he comes to the conclusion that the store robbery and murder has to do with another that occurred recently. As the investigation continues, Terry's stress increases, causing his recent transplant to hurt more and more. But the murders are there and the former agent is convinced that he will be able to find a relationship between them all that will bring to light the culprit. This Clint Eastwood film exists in the same universe as "The Innocent." But despite his most famous roles playing Dirty Harry and other cops, this FBI agent is the last of Clint's incarnations as a detective.

programme.title: The agent
programme.desc: In the year 2030, the world is in a permanent state of economic recession and faces serious environmental problems as a result of global warming. All those citizens who are unproductive are exiled to a colony.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Filmed entirely in the Philippines, "Platoon" tells us about the year a young university student named Chris spends in a regiment, who decides to volunteer in the Vietnam War. First part of a trilogy directed and written by Oliver Stone about the Vietnam War (followed by Born on the Fourth of July and Between Heaven and Earth). The protagonist of this story is a young Charlie Sheen, accompanied by a cast among which we highlight Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger or some at that time still unknown Forest Whitaker or Johnny Depp. "Platoon" was the first film about Vietnam written and directed by a veteran of that war. Oliver Stone created this masterpiece taken from the experiences that he himself lived on the battlefield in his year as a soldier, filming almost a documentary where he tells us in first person through a character named Chris all his experiences in Vietnam. We are thus witnessing one of the most precise and realistic war films that recount this conflict with excellent direction, a script and impeccable editing. As for the exteriors, they are very well detailed and this perfection makes the viewer quickly immerse themselves in the war atmosphere that surrounds everything without rest. Definitely, a spectacular film that shows what until then Hollywood always tried to hide and the best way to get closer to what those days in Vietnam really were. Classic of the eighties and universal cinema.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: Young JR is accused and imprisoned for a minor crime. When he enters prison he discovers the harshness of life in prison, but he will soon become the protégé of Brendan Lynch, one of the most dangerous prisoners in Australia. However, that protection will have a price and Lynch, along with his team, will have plans for JR when he is released from prison: help them with their escape plan.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War broke out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that captures the viewer's attention at all times.

programme.title: natural born killers
programme.desc: Mickey and Mallory are two young people who, in love and maddened, murder the girl's father in cold blood and begin a flight. The host of a sensationalist program decides to take advantage of the fascination that his personality exerts on the public to turn the murderers into television heroes.

programme.title: The law of the street
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy joins a gang in Washington, but he is determined that his 10-year-old brother will not follow in his footsteps. Everything indicates that this will be his destiny, until he meets a war veteran.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, commander of the team, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: I continue like God
programme.desc: Popular Buffalo reporter Evan Baxter has just become a congressman, so he moves with his family to a luxurious development in Huntsville, Virginia. Everything seems to be going well for the Baxter family, who are focused on adjusting to their new luxury-filled life away from their hometown. Evan is expectant since in his first days as a congressman, the powerful Congressman Long proposes that he work together with his team in the development of a bill, which makes him think that God has heard his prayers and that professional success has finally knocked on his door. However, Evan's future begins to falter when one day a man who calls himself God appears at his house and entrusts him with an important mission of biblical proportions: build an ark to save a pair of each animal species and thus save humanity from the approaching universal flood. Even though Evan is skeptical and considers the man crazy, when pairs of all kinds of animals begin to arrive in his garden and different suppliers begin to knock on his door bringing enormous quantities of wood and other materials, Evan is forced to believe in God and forcibly accept the order. Resigned and with the help of his three children and the manual 'Build Arks for Dummies', Evan begins his important task. During the process, many will consider Evan crazy and begin to call him 'The Noah of New York' as he will undergo a significant transformation, both physically and mentally.

programme.title: Matar a Santa
programme.desc: Chris, also known as Santa Claus, is forced to team up with the military to save his business. To make matters a little worse, he finds himself involved in a deadly battle against a hitman hired by a 12-year-old boy.

programme.title: Men in Black: International
programme.desc: Sweet Molly Wright has a life-changing experience as a child; Help an alien who is being sought by two agents of the MiB organization escape. Twenty years after what happened, and after much physical and intellectual preparation, she manages to present herself as a candidate to join the CIA and the FBI, but no one believes her story and she is rejected for her delusions with alien life. Despite this, Molly does not give up and manages to track down an alien landing that leads her directly to the MiB headquarters in New York City. His adventure begins from that moment, he leaves life as he knows it behind and becomes a testing agent for the MiB branch in the city of London. The tenacious and cunning Molly has to prove her abilities to stay in the MiB. To do this, he manages to get involved in a difficult mission as the assistant of the presumptuous Agent H. Both agents will have to iron out their rough edges and work as a team to solve two serious problems; the appearance of a mole that would call into question the impeccable reputation of the MiB and the threat of two alien beings that endangers life on Earth and the balance of the universe. Men in Black: International is a new installment of the famous Men in Black franchise. It becomes the fourth film and spin-off of the original MIB saga. It stars Chris Hemsworth, Tessa Thompson and Liam Neeson and much of its filming took place in the cities of New York, Morocco, Italy and London. The actor and producer Felix Gary Gray was in charge of directing this film.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Hitman. Agent 47
programme.desc: Based on the famous video game, Hitman is an elite assassin who has been genetically modified to become a perfect killing machine. Identified only by a barcode that he has tattooed, his target is a corporation that aims to reveal his past and create assassins more powerful than him.

programme.title: The flight
programme.desc: Commander Whip Whitaker is forced to make an emergency landing of the aircraft he is piloting, thereby saving many lives. He is considered a hero, until the subsequent investigation reveals that he had used narcotics the night before the incident. The pilot faces a trial in which he must put his career and his own life in order.

programme.title: Conan the destroyer
programme.desc: Queen Taramis entrusts Conan with a very dangerous mission: to accompany Princess Jehnna on a long journey for which she was born predestined. Their objective is to recover a jewel that is in the possession of a powerful sorcerer. If he succeeds, the queen promises that she will help him recover Valeria, his great love. But the monarch's intentions are very different since with the jewel she wants to bring an ancient god back to life.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: The Edge
programme.desc: Second part of Charlie's Angels. Dylan, Natalie and Alex are sent by their boss on a new mission: locate a group of rings that have been stolen from the Department of Justice. This device allows its owner to know the list of people who are in the FBI's Witness Protection Program. When the first witnesses begin to appear dead, the Angels will have to use all their ingenuity to solve the case. An exceptional cameo can be seen in this film: one of the original Angels, Jaclyn Smith.

programme.title: Better... impossible
programme.desc: Melvin Udall is a novelist with obsessive-compulsive disorder that, among other things, causes him to walk down the street without stepping on sidewalk lines or to use new cutlery every time he eats. But Melvin also feels proud of his ability to offend and irritate others, especially his neighbor Simon Nye, a homosexual artist whom the writer always attacks with his viperous tongue. Melvin has breakfast every day in a cafeteria and there is only one waitress who can put up with him, Carol, a single mother struggling to raise her asthmatic son. The fate of these characters will be intertwined because of a dog and a trip.

programme.title: Crank: High voltage
programme.desc: Hitman Chelios faces off against a Chinese gangster who has stolen his virtually indestructible heart and replaced it with a sophisticated battery-powered device that requires frequent bursts of electricity to continue functioning.

programme.title: A crime has been cooked: The mystery of the chocolate cookie
programme.desc: Hannah Swensen is a young baker who lives in a quiet town where everyone knows and secrets don't stay hidden for long. Hannah's place is one of the most frequented and where the most gossip is known. One day, Hannah finds her delivery man shot dead in the alley of her store. From that moment, Hannah becomes an amateur detective to solve the case.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Texas. Two years before the American Civil War broke out. King Schultz is a German bounty hunter who is tracking murderers to collect for their heads, and he promises the black slave Django to set him free on the condition that he helps him catch them. Django accepts, since his greatest wish is to go rescue his wife Broomhilda, a slave who is on the plantation of landowner Calvin Candie. This film, written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, is a western film with references to the spaghetti western genre; genre through which I wanted to portray a story about slavery like this one. Tarantino is a renowned American director, producer and screenwriter whose films are characterized by addressing non-linear stories, violence, Grindhouse influences, kung fu and spaghetti westerns. Starring Jamie Foxx ('Bait', 'Collateral'), Christoph Waltz ('Inglourious Basterds', 'Dorian'), Leonardo DiCaprio ('Titanic', 'The Great Gatsby') and Samuel L. Jackson ('S.W.A.T.', 'Star Wars'); The film is a mix of good dialogue, rhythm, irony, and an impeccable soundtrack that captures the viewer's attention at all times.

programme.title: Demolition
programme.desc: A successful executive struggles to understand his emotional disconnection after the sudden and tragic death of his wife in a car accident. Despite his father-in-law's pressure to recover, Davis remains bewildered and reflects this by compulsively disassembling increasingly conspicuous objects around him.

programme.title: The jury
programme.desc: A young New Orleans widow files a civil lawsuit against a powerful corporate consortium whom she blames for her husband's death. Thus, a multimillion-dollar case is launched. Judicial thriller based on a novel by John Grisham, a best-selling writer who is well versed in all the ins and outs of United States law.

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: A very dangerous alien has escaped from the high-security prison on the Moon with the help of his exuberant admirer. The alien is called "Boris the Animal", a ruthless being that Agent K. captured in 1969 and whom they must face again. Unaware of Boris's escape, K. (Tommy Lee Jones) and J. (Will Smith) continue carrying out their work as M.I.B. agents. ridding the city of dangerous aliens or aliens with petty crimes. At the beginning of a new day, J. can't find his partner anywhere, but that's not the most worrying thing, no one at the agency seems to know of his existence. In his investigation he will realize that Boris has made a jump in time and has killed K. completely changing history and causing the Earth to be unprotected against an imminent alien attack. J. will have to travel back in time to recover his partner and save the future of the planet. Specifically, he will travel to the year 1969, when K. is still a young agent with a certain sense of humor. Together they will try to catch the evil Boris. To do this, they will have the intermittent and relative help of a character who is capable of seeing all the space-time lines of the Universe at every moment. The film began filming without a definitive script, so production was delayed due to all the rewrites that were done until it was completed. For the role of Boris, the participation of actor Sacha Baron Cohen, known for his leading roles in the films "Borat" and "The Dictator", was reconsidered. But in the end the role was awarded to Jemaine Clement. The makeup he wore to embody the alien took four and a half hours to apply each day of filming. Will Smith had his ups and downs with the film's director, Barry Sonnenfeld, because he wanted the person to play the role of the colonel's son to be his son, Jaden Smith, and not Cayen Martin, who ultimately got the role.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish is a boy who accidentally finds a board game called Jumanji and convinces his friend Sarah to try it, but very strange events begin to occur and the game will catch them and change their lives. By throwing the dice, Alan is transported to a parallel world, where he will not be able to leave until the game ends, but circumstances cause Sarah to leave and Alan is trapped for 26 years in that other world until two new children find the game and start playing.

programme.title: my sister's husband
programme.desc: Richard is a Cambridge professor who will find himself involved in an unexpected love triangle. After getting a young and attractive American student pregnant, he will also meet her sister, an eccentric novelist.

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: MI6 agent Ray Koval (Clive Owen) is in Dubai when he meets Claire Stenwick (Julia Roberts). After groping her a little, he manages to win her over and they spend the night together, without knowing that Claire is part of the CIA. When Ray wakes up the next day, the woman has disappeared with several compromised documents. For years, Ray searches for her, leaves his job at MI6 and gets a new one in the espionage department of a large multinational. In his third week of work he meets Claire again. Now they both work as spies for large companies and Claire is not willing to allow anyone to come and destroy the professional future she has been building for just over a year. The two spies will use all kinds of tricks to keep their positions, but they will also have to fight against the great attraction they feel for each other so as not to succumb to the other person's deceptions. In this film, actor Clive Owen plays MI6 spy Ray Koval. Owen began his career in television, working mainly on not very well-known series. Currently, although he still makes some stellar appearances on television, he is one of the best-known faces on the big screen. He has worked in films such as 'The Bourne Affair', 'King Arthur' and 'Closer' where he shares the bill for the first time with actress Julia Roberts. In 'Duplicity', Roberts plays Claire Stenwick, a retired CIA agent. The acclaimed actress began her career in 1987, in the series 'The History of Crime'. After that she worked in several films until she gained fame through 'Pretty Woman' and her starring role alongside actor Richard Gere. From there her career took off and her charming smile made her 'America's Sweetheart'. He played several leading roles in romantic comedies but he has always tried to combine it with more serious roles such as those he played in 'Stay by me' or 'Erin Brockovich'.

programme.desc: The Yellow River - running for almost five and half thousand kilometres from west to east - is known as China's mother river. It's hailed as the cradle of Chinese civilisation and over thousands of years, it has fed billions of people and inspired generations of artists. Alastair explores the Yellow River and discovers some of the finest artwork from its valley, to understand how this unique natural phenomenon is deeply connected with the identity of the Chinese and the roots of their culture.

programme.title: AI Decoded

Presenter Marc Cieslak is joined by digital rights activist Cory Doctorow, AI entrepreneur Priya Lakhani and academic Dr Ella Hafermalz to unpack the biggest questions facing AI today.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: An AI-generated actor called Tilly Norwood has been cast in the lead role of a forthcoming film, adding to the debate about artificial intelligence in filmmaking. The announcement follows criticism from actors such as Emily Blunt, and objections from the US performers' union. Eline Van der Velden, founder and CEO of Particle6, explains why she created Tilly Norwood, while Jake Kanter, international investigations editor at Deadline, sets out the reaction from the film industry. Andy Burnham has become the UK's new prime minister, and his approach to the media is already attracting attention. programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. programme.desc: Just how long can Iran afford to keep fighting the US? programme.title: Undangan Kampung Ronggeng
programme.desc: Agni mendapat undangan untuk menghadiri Pertunjukkan Seni Tari Ronggeng di kampung Ronggeng.Tidak diketahui siapa pengirim undangan itu.Agni dan kedua temannya memutuskan untuk datang . Kejadian-kejadian aneh pun mereka alami.

programme.title: Jubah Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Sinta, gadis cantik dan ambisius dari keluarga kurang mampu. Setelah menemukan Jubah Tak Kasat Mata di toko Kr. Amat, dia menyusup masuk ke rumah Poppy dan mencuri uang dari brankas. Tapi ternyata jubah tersebut membawa kutukan.

programme.title: Putri Keong Mas
programme.desc: Puteri diserahkan kepada seorang dukun oleh ibu tirinya yang sangat kejam. Sejak saat itu, puteri hidup sebagai keong emas, dan hanya bisa kembali sebagai manusia jika ada seorang pemuda yang jatuh cinta kepadanya.

programme.title: Pangeran Kodok
programme.desc: Joshua meminta nasihat pada Ki Abra yang memberinya mantra, namun mantra tersebut hanya bisa dipakai sekali dan tidak boleh salah ucap. Saat mencoba mantranya, Joshua melakukan kesalahan besar terjadi.

programme.title: Manusia Ikan Jatuh Cinta
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya bangkrut, Risa terpaksa pindah ke sebuah kampung dekat laut. Di sana, saat dia nyaris tenggelam, tiba-tiba ada yang membawanya ke permukaan. Saat tersadar, dia hanya melihat sekilas manusia dengan sirip ikan.

programme.title: Herry Porter Pembawa Cinta
programme.desc: Maya mencari kerja di Bandung dan tinggal di rumah budenya. Maya pun diterima bekerja di sebuah toko textil. Heri, seorang porter, bekerja di tempat yang sama. Mereka kerap bertengkar, tapi perlahan mereka menjadi dekat.

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik dan ia bersembunyi di hutan.

programme.title: Cintaku Di Kejar Cicilan
programme.desc: Andre adalah pria tampan yang selalu bergaya dengan barang-barang mewah. Namun, semua itu dibeli Andre dengan berutang, akhirnya dia pun dikejar cicilan yang menumpuk.

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak.

programme.title: Factory Cinta
programme.desc: Karin melaksanakan tugas KKN di sebuah desa terpencil selama dua minggu. Merasa bosan, dia dan sahabatnya, Dinda, pergi ke kota untuk berbelanja tapi justru kemalingan dan tersesat. Lalu, Aman datang menyelamatkannya.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat : Teko 1001 Malam
programme.desc: Rani, cewek cupu yang dirundung teman-temannya dan kerap mendapat perlakuan buruk. Ia juga mendapat perlakuan kasar dari tantenya. Rani menemukan teko usang, ketika digosok keluar sosok jin yang bisa mengabulkan tiga permintaan.

programme.title: 7 Pusaka - Sabuk Penghilang Raga
programme.desc: Raga adalah seorang maling kelas teri yang bernasib sial. Saat dikejar para warga dan bersembunyi di dalam sebuah kali, tiba-tiba Raga menemukan sebuah koin gobang yang hanyut. Saat Raga menggenggam koin itu, ia menghilang.

programme.title: Punched by Love
programme.desc: Meskipun ibunya melarang, Indah tetap ingin menjadi seorang petinju. Saat sanggar tinju mengeluarkannya karena kesalahan pengisian data, Indah belajar kepada seorang rekan sesama petinju. Dan cinta tumbuh di antara mereka berdua.

programme.title: 7 Hari Kemudian
programme.desc: Mike, cowok playboy sekolah terkenal suka mempermainkan cewek. Fika mantan pacar Mike meninggal dunia karena bunuh diri. Amanda dan teman-temannya berencana membuat jera Mike. Mereka mengatur strategi untuk menjebak Mike.

programme.title: Misteri Sosok Sang Ibu
programme.desc: Iroh memiliki tiga anak, Sarah, Kanaya, dan Husein.Dia meninggal setelah terpeleset masuk ke kubangan air. Sang suami memiliki kemampuan memanggil arwah, Iroh dipanggil untuk menemani Husein tanpa diketahui anak-anaknya yang lain

programme.title: Ketemu Cinta Di Online Shop
programme.desc: Rayya adalah mahasiswa yang menekuni bisnis online. Dia mendapat saingan yaitu Pras, teman kampusnya yang juga punya bisnis toko online. Setelah kalah bersaing, Pras bekerja untuk Rayya, dan mereka saling jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Ketemu Cinta Di Online Shop

The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang berperan sebagai Pangeran ke-13, seorang petarung muda yang perkasa. Status istimewa yang ia miliki menimbulkan kecemburuan dan perseteruan keluarga yang mengerikan.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Film komedi ini bercerita tentang cinta terlarang dan senjata ajaib. Sepasang kekasih harus memperoleh kembali pedang titular dan membalas dendam atas pembunuhan yang terjadi di masa lalu mereka!

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: Kisah luar biasa tentang seorang pendekar wanita kejam yang bertekad untuk menangkap pembunuh orangtuanya.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: 72 penghuni rumah petak nan kumuh hidup di bawah pengawasan pemilik rumah yang tak berperasaan dan suami jahatnya. Namun, kedatangan seorang penyewa baru nan berani, mengubah nasib mereka.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Cheng-ying dan saudarinya memasuki kehidupan Lin Hao nan kejam demi menjalankan rencana untuk membalas kematian ayah mereka dengan memanfaatkan Jurus Tangan Pengunci Shaolin yang mematikan.

programme.title: Fangs Of The Cobra
programme.desc: Film thriller nan unik ini sama sekali tidak seseram judulnya, berkisah tentang seekor ular gagah berani dan berbudi luhur yang merusak perangkap, melawan tikus pemakan bayi, dan bahkan mengalahkan sejumlah geng saingan.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho berperan sebagai pendekar pedang wanita yang ditakuti. Ia pernah menyaksikan ayahnya disiksa dan ibunya diperkosa. 18 tahun berlalu sejak peristiwa itu, ia berencana untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Kaisar Chien Lung melakukan penyamaran untuk berbaur dengan rakyatnya dan memahami kebutuhan mereka. Ia mengalami hal aneh di sepanjang jalan, termasuk ditangkap dan hampir dipenggal. Siapa yang akan menyelamatkannya?

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng kabur ke San Francisco setelah dijebak atas kepemilikan narkoba. Ia membantu geng Naga Putih nan terkenal, yang dipimpin oleh Philip Kwok, dalam perang antargeng yang mengerikan, tapi ia dikhianati.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: Sekuel dari The Empress Dowager ini melanjutkan kisah Kaisar Guangxu dan Ibu Suri Cixi. Terlepas dari penobatan Guangxu sebagai raja, kemampuannya untuk memerintah secara efektif dibayangi oleh kekuatan Cixi.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: Dunia seni bela diri akan kacau jika dua penjahat besar, Winged Tiger dan Underworld King bergabung. Hal ini akan terjadi dengan pernikahan antara saudara perempuan dari Underworld King dan Winged Tiger.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David jatuh cinta pada Dan Feng dan menikahinya. Saudari David yang bernama Mona jatuh cinta dengan sahabatnya, Han Ming. Karena cemburu, Mona berbohong tentang perselingkuhan antara Han Ming dan Dan Feng.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Kueh Chih Hung, sang sutradara pujaan, menampilkan kisah tragedi romantis tentang arwah Lo Meng yang berupaya merasuk ke dalam tubuh cinta sejatinya, namun upayanya justru menjadi bumerang.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang adalah seorang seniman bela diri terkenal yang dipaksa untuk mengajarkan kung fu ke Klan Mong, sebuah klan jahat yang mencoba menghancurkan musuh bebuyutannya, Klan Chow.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang adalah seorang seniman bela diri terkenal yang dipaksa untuk mengajarkan kung fu ke Klan Mong, sebuah klan jahat yang mencoba menghancurkan musuh bebuyutannya, Klan Chow.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Kisah ini terjadi di sebuah apartemen kuno yang dihuni oleh berbagai karakter. Seorang pengembang properti berupaya memiliki apartemen itu untuk dibangun kembali.

programme.title: The 8 Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: Bangsa Mongol, dengan bantuan seorang informan, menyergap keluarga Yang yang berpengaruh, para pembela dinasti. Bangsa Mongol harus memburu semua anggota keluarga Yang yang selamat agar rencana jahat mereka untuk menggulingkan dinasti tidak terbongkar.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Dua teman masa kecil di sebuah komunitas terpencil bersumpah untuk hidup bersaudara selamanya. Peristiwa tragis pun dimulai ketika beberapa tahun kemudian salah seorang dari mereka ingin menikah.

programme.title: Owls & Mice
programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. Ia berusaha mendapatkan teman di sekolah barunya sebelum perkemahan musim gugur sekolah dimulai, tetapi ternyata hal itu lebih sulit dari yang dibayangkannya. Di rumah, ia berteman dengan seekor tikus kecil yang tinggal di kamar barunya, yang ia beri nama Peepeep. Ketika seekor burung hantu menangkap tikus kecil tersebut, Meral menyalahkan teman-teman barunya. Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. OWLS & MICE adalah sekuel dari FROGS & TOADS yang sukses dan memenangkan berbagai penghargaan, dari penulis dan sutradara yang sama, Simone van Dusseldorp.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Alan is joined at Manor Farm this time by legendary singer Petula Clark - who talks about her illustrious career - Midsomer Murders' Fiona Dolman, who chats about keeping DCI John Barnaby in check, and former NHS doctor-turned-comedian and author Adam Kaye, who talks about the power of laughter. Alan will also be taking a look the ancient art of horseback falconry and celebrating the very best in British chardonnay this time.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern Britton gets up-close-and-personal during the castration of a Bengal cat, and meets Amy the golden retriever and her devoted owner ahead of surgery to remove a lump from her mouth. Later, 12-week-old Labrador retriever puppy Tassie and her new owners are in for a vaccination, and returning canine patients Mono and Marley visit James for their one-year boosters. Pushkins the impatient Persian cat, also a repeat client, is back for help to remove her matted fur. A visiting surgical team is called into The Grove to attend to a bulldog's complex knee injury, and we venture out of the practice to see another specialist at work as clinical animal behaviourist Roz Pooley invites us to experience one of her puppy training classes.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Tuscany and Lazio, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind olive oil and the new techniques that are helping to grow rocket in Lazio. Arriving in stunning Tuscany just as the olive harvest begins, he joins Ricardo to learn how here oil is a matter of honour. Then Tom turns his hand to shaking the olives off the tree and join the taste test of the first press, a tradition handed down through the generations. Tom cooks up a feast to honour the harvest: a fig and extra virgin olive oil cake. His journey then takes him to Lazio, where rocket is an obsession. Giancarlo, a local producer, shows him how they get a peppery intensity into the leaves through careful cultivation. After a hard day's work Tom cooks his take on a family favourite: rocket pesto chicken parmigiana with a pesto pasta salad.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: This time Alan and his team are in Suffolk, where charity shop worker Eileen has a gravel drive and muddy borders as her only garden - with husband Roy suffering from Parkinson's, Eileen is desperate for a peaceful, pretty and safe space for them to share. To create a real garden, Alan designs an inward-looking intimate area surrounded by beautiful year-round colour for Roy and Eileen to enjoy - at the same time, Katie Rushworth is inspired by the couple's love of blues and pinks to plant a wrap-around border and building a covered seating area. Meanwhile, Frances Tophill is tasked with breaking up the vast expanse of fence with clever architectural planting and raised beds, and she must also design a bin store with living roof too - elsewhere, David Domoney heads to Wappenham Manor in Northamptonshire, where the front garden has been transformed into the most spectacular formal garden to welcome the owners home.

programme.title: Live and Let Die
programme.desc: The eighth entry in the James Bond film series and the first to star Roger Moore as 007. James Bond is sent to New York to investigate when three MI6 agents are killed whilst investigating the activities of Dr Kananga - the prime minister of the island of San Monique - and is soon on the trail of a Harlem crime kingpin known as Mr Big. Sensing links between Dr Kananga and Mr Big, Bond follows the men to Louisiana and the Caribbean - and uncovers a horrific plot to flood America with free heroin.

programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Are four celebrities clever enough to take on one of the country's finest quiz brains? Bradley Walsh hosts as Jayde Adams, Tony Cottee, Naughty Boy and The Vivienne take on the challenge in the hope of winning thousands of pounds for their chosen charities.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip. Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Barcelona to take on The Vixen and The Menace, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. Following a competitive opening quiz and a series of city-wide challenges - including hunting for graffiti art, tackling a theme park drop ride, and playing a football shirt game - the competition remains unpredictable and the race is tight with a dramatic finale.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. programme.desc: Ditto mengisahkan seorang mahasiswa teknik di sebuah universitas bernama Kim Yong. Dia mulai masuk kuliah tahun 1995, namun harus cuti hingga tahun 1999 karena menjalani wajib militer. Suatu hari, Yong menemukan sebuah radio antik yang bisa terhubung dengan masa depan. Yong berkomunikasi dengan Kim Mu-Nee, seorang mahasiswi yang hidup dimasa sekarang, berkuliah di jurusan sosiologi. programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: The north of Thailand is a popular travel destination, not just for adventurous individual tourists. The north is known for its mountainous, densely forested areas and therefore this region is also a paradise for motorcyclists. Thousands of curves on well-developed roads with little traffic and a diversity of culture and landscape make this region a perfect holiday destination for us to escape the winter in Germany for the fourth time. We will take you on a 1600 km long motorcycle tour to the most beautiful places in northern Thailand. (Station info).

Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks. (Senderinfo).

programme.sub-title: Icon of the New Heritage wave: BMW R nineT
programme.desc: In 2013, the BMW R nineT, a puristic retro roadster, came onto the market that one would not have expected from the brand from Munich, which is considered to be conservative. The modern technology is deliberately prepared for individual conversion to custom bikes, which are becoming increasingly popular in the young motorcycle scene worldwide. We show what idea lies behind the concept of the retro roadster and what qualities and possible weaknesses the classic boxer motorcycle reveals in the practical test. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: Of what used to be over 300 tractor manufacturers, only three remain in Germany today. One of them is DEUTZ. In addition to the change in tractor construction from the simple tractor to the all-rounder with over 100 possible work steps, Made in Germany also shows the lean and efficient production and assembly, which is still largely manual work. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.sub-title: IAA Mobility 2021 – A trade fair is moving
programme.desc: Something had to happen! New name, new location, new trade fair concept. After the decline in visitors in recent years, the International Motor Show is moving from Frankfurt to Munich. In addition to the exhibition halls, visitors can visit the free open space or take test drives. Over 100 premieres from the automotive sector show where the mobility of the future is headed. (Station info).

programme.title: Dream Cars
programme.desc: Whether Jaguar, Rolls Royce or Bentley, Aston Martin or McLaren, Dream Cars - England shows the most exciting, beautiful and fastest dream cars from Great Britain. programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of sophisticated tin bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: It is the "Holy Grail" for Porsche fans and the first Porsche to ever bear the famous name of the design genius from Austria: The Type 64, a racing car from 1938 that is based on the Volkswagen developed by Professor Ferdinand Porsche. Only two of the streamlined cars were built and were intended to take part in a race from Berlin to Rome. But the war intervened... (channel info).

programme.title: Cars + Life
programme.desc: The new mobile magazine presents the latest trends and innovations in the automotive industry every week. Whether compact everyday heroes, windy city runabouts for the urban jungle, beefy SUVs for family trips or modern electric and hydrogen vehicles: our experts will take you on a test drive through the world of automobility of today and tomorrow. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Le Mans. The toughest car race in the world. Porsche has competed in the 24-hour classic every year since 1951. The prototypes from Zuffenhausen won 16 times – more often than any other manufacturer in Le Mans history. There are also over 100 class victories. No other brand has shaped the race like Porsche. And no other race is as closely associated with Porsche as Le Mans. Porsche at Le Mans is an incredible success story. (Station info).

programme.title: Nordschleife
programme.desc: Today we start with our Nordschleife tourists, who - as soon as the track is a little drier - appear again at the ring and pursue their favorite hobby: accelerate and let the tires smoke! (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Rear view mirror
programme.desc: The highlights from all eras of automobile history: When the brand new Mercedes A-Class fell over in the moose test, when Stirling Moss won the Mille Miglia in record time, when Ferdinand Porsche amazed the world with an electric car in 1900. programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The stuntheroes from Action Concept are tough professionals. They throw themselves off houses, cause cars to fly or explode. We sent our reporter Dean Malay to Action Concept to get to know the people, the characters behind the hard shell. Stunt coordinator Domi shows Dean the work processes at Action Concept, but also explains why the stuntman is called Tobi, Heidi. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic

A day full of driving fun for the participants with a wide variety of special tests guarantees the best entertainment for the top speed spectators in this episode. (Station info).

programme.title: Rear view mirror
programme.desc: The highlights from all eras of automobile history: When the brand new Mercedes A-Class fell over in the moose test, when Stirling Moss won the Mille Miglia in record time, when Ferdinand Porsche amazed the world with an electric car in 1900. programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The stuntheroes from Action Concept are tough professionals. They throw themselves off houses, cause cars to fly or explode. Without the necessary seriousness and constant concentration when carrying out your work, nothing works. Stunt coordinator Domi shows Dean the work processes at Action Concept, but also explains why the stuntman is called Tobi, Heidi. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic

A day full of driving fun for the participants with a wide variety of special tests guarantees the best entertainment for the top speed spectators in this episode. (Station info).

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: Classic motorcycles are back in fashion. Honda is also reflecting on its great tradition and with the CB 1100 EX has revived a big bike that could have ridden on our streets in the flashy seventies. Nostalgic spoke wheels complete the design of the elegant four-cylinder bike with sufficient 94 hp power, more than enough for a relaxed cruise into the sunset. How does the CB 1100 EX compare to rivals like the BMW R nineT? The Japanese classic in the MOTORVISION TV driving test. (Station info).

programme.title: Mission Mobility

These vehicles were forgotten for over 60 years - until Mercedes-Benz revived the luxury brand in 2002. (Station info).

programme.title: Nordschleife
programme.desc: Racing legend Jackie Stewart once described the Nordschleife of the Nürburgring as a multi-limbed monster and gave it the name “Green Hell”. Once through the “Green Hell” – a dream for many that no one has to stay. Nordschleife fans take the spectators on board and tell them what they associate with the ring. (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Crete is the largest of the Greek islands and a motorcycle paradise. Curves overlooking the sea, mountain passes up to 1200m and sensational panoramas, gorges and hospitable people. We started our day tours to experience Crete from the Robinson Club in Ierapetra. The documentary shows the most beautiful mountain roads and bays in the eastern part of the island. Our day tours led to the famous Dikti Mountains. This film also shows the Lasithi plateau, the famous Vai Beach and a tour to the former hippie village and the caves of Matala. The highlight is the ride up to the mountain village of Ethia on what is probably one of the most spectacular (station info).
